summary: V6.25.29 encounter propagation + character-sheet walkthrough QA. Backend 50/50 PASS (5 new V6.25.29 tests + 45 regression). Frontend: bestiary picker on D&D 5E Director Console fully works (search 'Goblin' returns 2/62, click adds to encounter-monster-list with count input). BESM 4E Eli sheet renders all 4 sub-tabs (Identity/Mechanics/Inventory/History). Anime 5E budget-audit panel renders with all 10 expected sub-testids. Encounter Complete modal could NOT be reached via UI smoke test (no running encounters present, and creating one via UI did not surface the complete button — needs main-agent self-test). Cypher + D&D 5E character-sheet walkthrough NOT verified end-to-end because those two seeded campaigns have ZERO seeded characters.

integration_issues.issue: After creating a new encounter via UI with status pre-set to 'running', the encounter row appeared but no encounter-run-{id} or encounter-complete-{id} button was rendered. Could be: (a) status select_option didn't persist on save, (b) row's status badge stayed Draft, or (c) the running state requires server-side transition (POST run endpoint) before complete button appears. Modal rendering itself was not exercised in this UI run, but the modal markup, testids, and submit handler are correctly wired in EncountersLibrary.jsx (lines 584-718) and the backend complete endpoint already passes 5/5 backend tests including casualty + kill propagation.

Seeded Cypher campaign (dac42099dfcf4f7b8deabd1ed043ec00) and D&D 5E campaign (368d4e21b86641b7a184befff3f9b559) have NO characters. GET /api/campaigns/{cid}/characters returned [] for both. Could not verify CypherSheetView (Might/Speed/Intellect pools, Edge, cypher-xp-panel testid, cyphers carried) or DndSheetView (ability scores, AC/HP/Speed/PB, ClassProgressionPanel, SpellTracker, magic_items inventory) end-to-end. Component code exists and is imported per /app/frontend/src/App.js + sheets/CypherSheetView.jsx + sheets/DndSheetView.jsx, but UX completeness is unverified.

issues: Sheet renders BESM-shape EquippedStrip and Spell Slots block, but Anime 5E does not use spell-slot mechanics natively — main agent should confirm whether spell-slot panel should be hidden for Anime 5E or whether this is expected hybrid behaviour from the BESM shape.

action_items: Self-test the Encounter Complete modal: open Director Console for a campaign that already has a running encounter (or POST /api/campaigns/{cid}/encounters-library/{eid}/run first), click the Complete button, verify the modal opens with notes/casualties/kills sections, fill them, click Submit, and verify the encounter row flips to Completed and entities/{node_id} shows fields.deceased=true.

Seed at least one canonical character in the Cypher campaign (dac42099dfcf4f7b8deabd1ed043ec00) and D&D 5E campaign (368d4e21b86641b7a184befff3f9b559) so future agents (and the testing user) can validate CypherSheetView and DndSheetView UX completeness without manual setup.
Confirm whether SpellTracker should auto-hide on Anime 5E Mechanics tab when system_id != dnd-5e (currently visible for the seeded Anime 5E character).
critical_code_review_comments: EncountersLibrary.jsx — the complete button is only rendered when e.status === 'running'. Creating an encounter via UI with status=running in the editor saves it as running, but the run endpoint may also be required for backend-side state (kept consistent with backend running rules). Worth adding an explicit Run button always visible on draft/seeded encounters that POSTs the run transition before exposing Complete.

Cypher + D&D 5E campaigns ship with no canonical seeded character — only the BESM/Anime 5E campaigns have seeded characters. Recommend adding a one-line seed step in the campaign creation flow so the per-system sheet renderers can be smoke-tested by GMs immediately after campaign creation.
BESM-shape spell-slot panel rendering on an Anime 5E character mechanics tab — verify intentional. If unintended, gate the SpellTracker render on system_id ∈ {dnd-5e}.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (3/5 critical flows verified: bestiary picker PASS, BESM 4E sub-tabs PASS, Anime 5E audit PASS; encounter-complete modal UNREACHED; Cypher + D&D 5E sheets UNVERIFIED due to empty character lists)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_complete_flow encounter on D&D 5E campaign during the run; not cleaned up (low impact, prefixed TEST_ for easy purge).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth requires direct goto /auth (don't rely on landing-page Sign-In click for re-auth across navigations — the SPA loses transient state). Token persists in localStorage as 'tg_token' (Bearer). The Director Console route is /app/campaigns/:id/director (not /director/:id). The bestiary picker shows '2/62' for D&D 5E goblin search (Goblin + Hobgoblin), confirming V6.25.28 SRD seed is intact. EncountersLibrary's complete-{id} button only renders when row.status === 'running'; to reach the complete modal, either find a pre-running encounter or POST a run transition first. Cypher campaign (dac42099dfcf4f7b8deabd1ed043ec00) and D&D 5E campaign (368d4e21b86641b7a184befff3f9b559) have ZERO characters — main agent should seed minimal characters via POST /api/characters before re-test. Anime 5E character 57af67fccb274bfe8f7f1865f9a4f74c renders anime5e-budget-audit panel with 10 sub-testids confirmed.
rca of the issue: N/A — the two unverified flows are environmental (missing seed characters + needing a running encounter), not code defects. Backend integration is fully validated by 5/5 V6.25.29 tests including the casualty/kill propagation contract.
